calls.statement:
-- First, find the store and product information
SELECT 
  s.store_key,
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  p.product_key,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  fsw.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 100011
  AND s.store_name ILIKE '%Jyväskylä%Palokka%'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
